headline: See sentiment analysis that reads tone, not just words
summary: Stop defending sentiment scores based on word lists. Tonar reads tone and context so your reports hold up in the boardroom.
facts: Proprietary AI models achieve a 3% word error rate on Nordic languages and dialects.
Sentiment is scored at the entity level.
Every mention links to the original audio.
benefits: Fewer false positives and missed threats
Competitor sentiment tracked side by side
Nordic language accuracy as the foundation
